newsitem.title: FINLAND: TT-TIETO TO JOIN EUROPEAN ADVISORY GROUP.
newsitem.headline: TT-TIETO TO JOIN EUROPEAN ADVISORY GROUP.

text.p: Finnish data services group TT Tieto said on Monday that European information technology consortium The Services Informatics Experts (SIX) Advisory Group had invited it to a become member of the group.
"The Services Informatics Expertise Advisory Group aims to help the development of information society ... and to function as a specialist for the EU," Tieto said in a statement.

Other members of the advisory group are French Cap Gemini, Dutch Cap Gemini NV, Danish CSC Datacentralen, Spanish Indra , Italian Finsiel, German SAP and Softlab , French-British Sema, French Sligos-Axime and German Softlab , Tieto said.
